scope: minimal new Cu specimen, not a migration of the full frozen production workspace

worldModel.shape: retained procedural lobe generator; a new namespaced child only
worldModel.structure: 3D scalar density and internal empty regions; no measured hydrometeor topology
worldModel.material: dimensionless cloud concentration with approximate optical scattering; liquid/ice microphysics absent
worldModel.surface: volume optical response; no false surface mesh claim
worldModel.environment: explicit humidity proxy and advection drivers
worldModel.history: initial state, ordered driver events, analytic integration and preserved explicit branches
worldModel.presentation: neutral inspection, studio and labelled diagnostics; existing environment workbench remains independent

fields.spatialScale: 38 x 14 x 32 km bounds; 192 x 112 x 160 validation grid; cells about 198 x 125 x 200 m

fields.uncertainty: unmeasured uncalibrated response, no thermodynamic interpretation
translation operator only; no momentum or wind-field solver

fields.coordinateSpace: camera ray through displaced object space
fields.spatialScale: 144 view samples; coefficient 2.4 per km times the density proxy
fields.temporalCorrelation: derived from current C and reference field
bounds: nonnegative; integration early-terminates at low transmission
fields.source: view.glsl main uses densityAt from locked cloud.glsl
fields.uncertainty: appearance attenuation, not calibrated cloud-water extinction

process.units: concentration dimensionless; time s; extinction coefficient in reciprocal km
process.validScale: whole cloud proxy in a bounded inspection scene
process.boundaryConditions: prescribed environmental reservoir; scalar source is zero at protected volume borders
process.conservationExemption: No physical water mass is represented. The prescribed appearance source/sink exchanges with an unmodelled reservoir. No mass conservation claim is made.

seedRules.legacyNoise: fixed seed-271 cache retained; legacy full generator has not been migrated into per-lobe stable identity streams

rendering.neutral: fixed camera, identity white balance, exposure 1, fixed linear clamp plus sRGB; no auto exposure or beauty filter
rendering.studio: three directional key/fill/rim lights, independent switch/direction/intensity/RGB controls; coarse self-shadow approximation
rendering.lightUnits: relative radiance; no claimed lux, lumen, Kelvin or spectral calibration
rendering.nativePixels: explicitly shown separately from CSS display size

missing: upstream Schema and validator byte provenance
stable per-process streams throughout legacy generator
temperature/pressure/ice/liquid source data and physical calibration
calibrated photometric lights and Kelvin support
reference visual comparison and user approvals
